children: AirBaltic's Chapter 11 funding plan is still subject to approval from the court, CEO Erno Hilden said on Monday, after the Latvian airline voluntarily filed for protection under the U.S. Bankruptcy Code in New York, seeking a financial restructuring.
The approval could come on Monday or Tuesday, Hilden added.
